summary.en: The Nordic arm of global day-zero company builder Antler, with offices in Stockholm, Oslo and Copenhagen (and a planned Finnish presence). Runs a six-month pre-seed programme investing €100k for 10%; raising a €150m Nordic Fund II (€50m first close), having received 13,650 applications in its first five years.

sources.title: Antler announces €50m first close of new Nordic fund
sources.supports: company-builder model, €150m fund / €50m close, €100k for 10%, six-month programme, geo, applications
sources.quote: new €150m Nordic fund with €50m closed to date ... "Startups currently on Antler's programme will receive €100k from the second fund, in exchange for 10% of the company." ... recruits individuals without established ideas or cofounders and runs a six-month programme ... Sweden, Norway, and Denmark ... plans to establish an incubator in Finland ... "received 13,650 applications from aspiring founders"

verification_notes: Antler is global (founded 2017/2018 in Singapore); this entry scopes its Nordic operation. Some secondary lists still cite older $110k/11% terms; Sifted's €100k/10% is the current primary figure.
